Pricing questions

Is there really no per-case charge?
None. Serving a heavy user is not free for us, but a meter changes how you use the tool. You start deciding whether a case is worth uploading, and that hesitation is exactly what makes software like this useless.
What does annual billing save me?
Two months. Solo is $1,490 instead of $1,788, Practice is $2,990 instead of $3,588, Firm is $5,990 instead of $7,188. You can switch to annual at any point and we credit the unused part of the month.
Can we pay by bank transfer or against an invoice?
On the Firm plan, yes. Bank transfer suits firms whose cards expire, rotate between partners, or need a purchase order. Ask and we will send an invoice with our bank details.
What happens after the trial?
Nothing automatic. The trial takes no card, so it cannot roll into a subscription. You choose a plan or you do not hear from us again.
What if I outgrow a plan mid-month?
Move up whenever you like and we charge the difference for the days remaining, not a fresh month. Moving down takes effect at your next renewal so you keep what you paid for.
Do you offer a discount for sliding-scale practice?
Yes. If a meaningful share of your caseload is sliding-scale or pro bono, write and tell us roughly what share. We will work something out. Ask.
Can I cancel and take my cases with me?
Yes, in one click, and your case files export in full including the source documents and every citation. Software that holds your work hostage does not deserve the business.
Will the price go up on me later?
Not while you keep the subscription. If we raise prices, you stay on what you signed up at for as long as you stay subscribed. That is a commitment, not a promotion.
